priority: extend free external comparison traffic to four lightweight cognition loops using the existing reusable build system

games.title: Flash Count
games.short_description: Count the target before the board disappears and keep up as rounds accelerate.
games.description: Flash Count is a rapid visual-memory challenge. Count the requested target while the board is visible, answer after it disappears and keep solving as the pace gets faster. The short loop is suited to replay, score-depth and challenge comparisons.

games.title: Quick Sum
games.short_description: Solve tiny arithmetic questions against a 30-second clock and chase a higher score.
games.description: Quick Sum is a 30-second speed-math game built for instant retries. Solve compact arithmetic prompts, protect accuracy and improve the number of correct answers per run. It provides a simple benchmark for replay, score progression and sharing.

games.title: Memory Path
games.short_description: Watch the tile path, repeat it from memory and progress through longer patterns.
games.description: Memory Path is a sequence-memory challenge. Watch a path flash across the board, repeat the pattern correctly and continue as the sequence becomes more demanding. The level-like progression creates clear depth, retry and return-play signals.

games.title: Higher or Lower
games.short_description: Predict whether the next number is higher or lower and protect the streak.
games.description: Higher or Lower is a fast prediction game centered on streak-building. Choose whether the next number will be higher or lower, continue while correct and retry immediately after a miss. The simple rule makes streak depth, repeat attempts and social score comparison easy to measure.
